verified_contracts: Composite DTM is a bare-earth raster covering about 99 percent of England at 1m resolution
newest best-resolution repeat surveys are selected and resampled data uses bilinear interpolation

input lidar surveys report plus or minus 15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
time-stamped DTM metadata identifies survey date resolution transformation and geoidal model
WCS NoData is a numeric sentinel and must not be promoted as elevation
